GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION 
DEPARTMENT OF HIGHER EDUCATION 
LOK SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 2493 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 1st AUGUST, 2022 
Promotion of Higher Education in Chhattisgarh and Jharkhand 
†2493.  SHRI MOHAN MANDAVI: 
SHRI CHUNNI LAL SAHU: 
SHRI SUDARSHAN BHAGAT: 
 
Will the Minister of EDUCATION be pleased to state:  
(a) whether the Government has formulated any  scheme to give a fillip to higher 
education in Baster,  Kanker, Gariyaband and Dhamtari districts of Chhattisgarh  and 
Jharkhand in the remote areas of the country; 
(b) if so, the details thereof; and 
(c) the details of the programmes launched by the  Government to promote higher 
education in the border, rural, tribal and hilly areas of the country during the last  five 
years? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION 
(Dr. SUBHAS SARKAR) 
(a) to (c): Education being in the Concurrent List, enhancing the quality of education 
is the responsibilit y of both th e Central and State Governments . However, 
recognizing the need for central assistance, the Central Government has 
implemented various schemes for supporting State Governments . Department of 
Higher Education is implementing a centrally sponsored scheme of Rashtriya 
Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan (RUSA) with aim to promote acces s, equity and quality, 
inter alia. The scheme provides central assistance to States under various 
components. Under RUSA, priority has been given to unserved and underserved 
areas such as educationally backward districts, Aspirational Districts, border, rural, 
tribal and hilly areas  etc. Under RUSA, projects worth Rs.  433.00 crores have been 
approved in Chhattisgarh including Rs.  44.00 crores  in the districts of Baster, 
Kanker, Gariyaband and Dhamtari and projects worth Rs. 630.24 crores have been 
approved in the State of Jharkhand.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA  
MINISTRY OF SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP  
  
LOK SABHA  
  
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 2494  
TO BE ANSWERED ON 01.08.2022  
  
DEVELOPMENT OF SPORTS UNDER SKILL INDIA INITIATIVE  
  
2494. SHRI JAGDAMBIKA PAL:  
  
Will the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRE NEURSHIP be 
pleased to state:  
  
(a) whether the Government has focused attention to  the development of sports under 
the Skill India Initiative; 
 
(b) if so, the details thereof; 
 
(c) whether the Government has conducted any skill gap study on Sports as yet; and 
 
(d) if so, the details thereof? 
  
ANSWER  
  
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF 
SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP  
(SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRASEKHAR) 
 
(a) The National Skill Development Mission (NSDM) w as launched by the Hon’ble Prime 
Minister on 15th July, 2015, to provide a strong in stitutional framework to implement and 
scale up skill development efforts across the country, in all sectors including sports. 
 
(b) Under this, the Ministry of Skill Development a nd Entrepreneurship (MSDE) is 
implementing its flagship scheme Pradhan Mantri Kau shal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY). Under 
PMKVY, skilling is provided in various sectors including sports. Qualification Packs that have 
been developed for the sports sector are Early Year s Physical Activity Facilitator, Primary 
Years Physical Activity Facilitator, Sports Masseur , Fitness Trainer, Community Sports 
Coach, Unarmed Self-Defence Instructor, Personal Fi tness Trainer, Group Fitness Trainer, 
Strength and Conditioning Coach, Fitness Centre Hea d, Lifeguard Pool, Lifeguard Open 
Water, Aquatic Rescue Head, Swimming Instructor, Be ach Captain and Pool Maintenance 
Worker. As on 30.06.2022, a total number of 91,007 candidates have been trained under 
PMKVY under sports sector. 
 
(c) and (d) MSDE through National Skill Development  Corporation (NSDC) formed the 
Sports, Physical Education, Fitness & Leisure Skill s Council (SPEFL-SC) on 3rd July, 2015 
for focused attention to the development of sports under the Skill India Initiative. The key 
objective of the SPEFL-SC is to create a robust and vibrant eco-system for quality education 
and skill development in the sports sector in the c ountry. The mandate for SPEFL-SC, inter 
alia, is to carry out functional and occupational mapping and develop a catalogue of industry, 
develop occupations/ job roles in the sector, devel op & put in place an assessment & 
certification mechanism for the trainers, assessors  and trainees, etc. This is an ongoing and 
continuous process. No skill-gap study has yet been undertaken for the sports sector.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF EDUCATION 
DEPARTMENT OF SCHOOL EDUCATION & LITERACY 
 
LOK SABHA 
 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.2495 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 01.08.2022 
 
OPENING KVs AND JNVs 
 
†2495. SHRI MUKESH RAJPUT:  
SHRI RAMPRIT MANDAL:  
SHRI ARUN KUMAR SAGAR:  
 
Will the Minister of EDUCATION be pleased to state:  
 
(a)  the number of new Kendriya Vidyalayas  (KVs) functioning at present and 
proposed to be opened in the country particularly in the State of Uttar Pradesh 
and Jhanjharpur District in the State of Bihar;  
(b)  whether any KVs has been proposed to be opened in Farrukhabad District in UP 
and if so, the details thereof;  
(c)  whether the Government proposes to open more KVs and JNVs in UP, 
particularly in Shahjahanpur and Bihar State and if so, the details thereof and if 
not, the reasons therefor; and  
(d)  the criteria for opening KVs and JNVs, especially in backward and rural areas of 
the country? 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION 
(SMT. ANNPURNA DEVI) 
 
(a) & (b) At present, 1248 Kendriya Vidyalayas (KVs) are functioning in the country 
including 122 KVs in the State of Uttar Pradesh  and 49 KVs in the State of Bihar. 
Opening of new KVs is a continuous process. Proposals for opening of new KVs are 
considered only if sponsored by Mini stries or Departments of the Government of India / 
State Governments / Union Territories (UTs) Administrations and committing resources 
for setting up a new KV. A new KV at Banda was sanctioned in August, 2018 but could 
not be made functional as the State Government of Uttar Pradesh has not provided the 
requisite land and suitable rent free temporary building as per the norms.  
 
Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan  (KVS) has not received any proposal in the 
prescribed proforma for opening of new KVs at Jhanjharpur district and Farrukhabad 
district from the State Government of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh respectively.  

(c) Opening of new KVs and Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (JNVs) is a continuous 
process. KVS has informed that 02 KVs namely Shahjahanpur Cantt. and Shahjahanpur 
No. 2 (OCF) are already functional in the Shahjahanpur district of Uttar Pradesh. KVS 
has not received any proposal in the prescribed proforma for opening of a new KV at 
Shahjahanpur district of Uttar Pradesh.  
 
New KVs in Nawada & Devkund (Aurangab ad) and 205 Cobra CRPF Bn. 
Barachatti  (Gaya) & 45 th BN SSB Beerpur (Supaul) were sanctioned in August, 2018 
and March, 2019 respectively but could not be made functional as the State Government 
of Bihar has not provided the requisite land and suitable rent free temporary building as 
per the norms. 
  
Navodaya Vidyalaya Scheme envisages for opening of one Jawahar Navodaya 
Vidyalaya (JNV) in each district of country.  All the districts of Uttar Pradesh and Bihar 
have been covered under the Navodaya Vidyalaya Scheme. At present, 76 JNVs 
including 1 additional JNV in Sitapur district (SC concentrated) in the State of Uttar 
Pradesh and 39 JNVs including 1 additional JNV in  Gaya district (SC concentrated) in 
the State of Bihar are functional.   
(d) KVs are opened primarily to cater to the educational needs of the wards of 
transferable Central Government employees including Defence & Para -Military 
personnel, Central Autonomous Bodies, Central Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) and 
Central Institute of Higher Learning (IHL) by providing a common programme of 
education throughout the country. KVs are not opened on the criteria of backward / rural. 
JNVs are opened for providing good quality modern education to the talented 
children predominantly from rural areas . At least 75% seats are reserved for the 
students from rural areas and almost all the JNVs have been established in rural / 
backward areas of the country. Opening of new JNVs depends on the willingness of the 
concerned State Government / UT administration to make available requisite suitable 
land free of cost for construction of the permanent building and making available 
required temporary building, free of rent, to run t he Vidyalaya till the permanent building 
is constructed. However, actual sanction and opening of new JNV depends on the 
availability of funds and approval by the Competent Authority. All the districts of the 
States/UTs (as on 31st May, 2014), which have ac cepted the Navodaya Vidyalaya 
Scheme, have been covered under this scheme.

LOK SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 2499 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 01.08.2022 
 
HOME DELIVERY AGENTS 
 
 †2499. SHRI GYANESHWAR PATIL: 
      SHRI NAYAB SINGH: 
 
      Will the Minister of LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be pleased to 
state: 
 
(a)whether the Government has formulated any policy for welfare, 
upliftment and safety of home delivery agents working with various 
delivery platforms;  
(b)if so, the details thereof and if not, the manner in which Government 
proposes to help the employees in this sector; 
(c)whether the Government maintains any integrated database of 
home delivery agents working in this sector; and  
(d)whether there is any complaint redressal mechanism for del ivery 
agents in case of violation of labour laws? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF STATE FOR LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT 
(SHRI RAMESWAR TELI) 
 
(a) to (d): There is no definition of gig workers in the existing central 
labour laws. However, the Code on Social Security, 2020, for the first 
time, defines gig workers and envisages social security benefits 
through formulation of schemes. It is provided in the Code on Social 
Security, 2020 to set up a Social Security Fund  and one of the sources 
of fund, is contribution from aggregator between 1 to 2% of annual 
turnover of an aggregator subject to the limit of 5% of the amount paid 
or payable by an aggregator to such workers. The Government has 
launched e-Shram portal on 26.08.2021 for registration and creation of 
a Comprehensive National Database of Unorganized Workers including 
gig and platform workers. It allows a person to register himself or 
herself on the portal on self -declaration basis, which is spread across 
around 400 occup ations.  It captures details of workers working in 
various occupations such as Delivery Boy/ Partner/ Delivery Associate 
for food & grocery/ Door -to-Door Salespersons, etc. including those 
working as gig and platform workers.
